Lab 1: Reliability of Soil Lead Measurements

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
soil <- read.csv('/courses/EDS222/data/exide-soil-cores.csv')
```

```{r}
# Explore soil df
head(soil, n = 5)
dim(soil)
names(soil)
```


```{r}
# Distribution of soil core lead measurements
ggplot(
    data = soil,
    mapping = aes(
        x = pb_ppm
    )
) +
    geom_histogram() +
    xlim(0,2000) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = 'blue') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = 'blue')
```


```{r}
# Distribution of property-level mean measurements
prop_means <- soil |>  
    summarise(mean_pb_ppm = mean(pb_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = property_id)

ggplot(
    data = prop_means,
    mapping = aes(
        x = mean_pb_ppm
    )
) +
    geom_histogram() +
    xlim(0,2000) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = 'blue') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = 'blue')
```


```{r}
# Property-level variability
prop_sd <- soil |>  
    summarise(sd_pb_ppm = sd(pb_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = property_id)

ggplot(
    data = prop_sd,
    mapping = aes(
        x = sd_pb_ppm
    )
) +
    geom_histogram() +
    xlim(0,1000) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = 'blue') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = 'blue')
```


```{r}
# Lead measurements by location
soil |> 
    distinct(location_code)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    data = soil,
    mapping = aes(
        x = pb_ppm
    )
) +
    geom_histogram() +
    xlim(0,2000) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = 'blue') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = 'blue') +
    facet_wrap('location_code')
```

```{r}
# Drip line vs. yard, at the property level
soil2 <- soil |> 
    mutate(is_dripline = ifelse(location_code == 'DL', TRUE, FALSE))|>
        summarise(mean_ppm = mean(pb_ppm),
        .by = c('property_id', 'is_dripline')) |> 
            pivot_wider(names_from = is_dripline, values_from = mean_ppm, names_prefix = 'dripline_') |> 
            mutate(difference = dripline_TRUE - dripline_FALSE)
head(soil2, n = 5)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
    data = soil2,
    mapping = aes(
        x = difference
    )
) +
    geom_histogram() +
    xlim(0,2000) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 80, color = 'blue') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = 'blue') 
```
